title: expand_url_template: nested/adjacent braces give misleading error
description: Input like '{foo{bar}}' causes find('}') on 'foo{bar}}' to return 3, producing name='foo{bar}'. This does not match any var and returns InvalidArgument('URL template variable not supplied: {foo{bar}}'). The error is technically correct but the message 'variable not supplied' is misleading when the real problem is a malformed template. This will confuse users debugging bad server session documents. A check that name contains only safe characters (alphanumeric + dash) would catch malformed templates with a better message.
